simple.meaning: מַגְזֵרָה (magzêrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a cutting implement , i.e. a blade.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַגְזֵרָה (H4037) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַגְזֵרָה (H4037) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַגְזֵרָה (magzêrâh) / H4037 is traced through 2 Samuel 12:31 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4037. magzerah [ מַגְזֵרָה ] noun feminine cutting instrument, axe — 2Sam 12:31 of David's treatment of captives, הַבַּרְזֶל וּבְמַגְזְרוֺת ֗֗֗ בַּמְּגֵרָה וַיָּשֶׂם . גֵחֲזִי see below גַּיְא גֹּ֫חִי see [ גּוֺחַ גִּיחַ, ]. גחל (probably = kindle, burn ).
